answer: Each identity begins with its vote and reward multiplier locked. An independent panel must verify ten successes, and the protocol unlocks 10% after each one, no more than once every seven days. A correct gale forecast can advance an account; copying a sonnet review fails verification. Even a valid summit safety audit cannot shorten the interval. Building 100 full-power Sybils therefore costs 1,000 distinct accepted jobs and at least 63 days of upkeep.
